			<style></style>		<div class="elementor-testimonial-wrapper">
							<div class="elementor-testimonial-content">Sal Island experience and knowledge will help you to learn kitesurfing and wingfoiling in the best conditions. With IKO certified instructors and the latest, safest gear from the German brand CORE Kiteboarding at the windy spot of Kite Beach, you are guaranteed an exceptional experience.
Come join our passionate and experienced family team. Learn Kite Surf and Wing Foil  from our pro rider Ricardo Bettencourt, born in Deutschland, "Hamburger Jung!", famously known as "the International Teacher." He speaks german and more 6 languages and brings a wealth of expertise to your learning journey.
Join us and master kite and wing foiling!</div>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
							<p>First we learn the basis and how to get used to a baby kite on the beach<br />Then you will go into the water for some bodydraguing. You will learn how to move down- and up- wind.<br />Finally, when you are at ease with the kite, you can practice the waterstart with the board at your feet. You will enjoy your first ride, make transitions, and maybe your first little jumps,&#8230;<br />You will learn priority rules, how to self-rescue, any what to do in any dangerous situation.</p>						</div>

			<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">RICARDO</h2>		</div>

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-ec9aed0 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="ec9aed0" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
							<p>Ricardo Bettencourt discovered his lifelong connection with the ocean when he moved with his mother from Hamburg, Germany, to Cape Verde at six. His passion for surfing started in Santa Maria and evolved into a deep love for kitesurfing. Fluent in German, he became an instructor in Europe and participated in various professional competitions. Certified by IKO, Ricardo is now the proud owner of a kitesurf school, ready to teach beginners, intermediates, and experts. His school embodies his expertise and passion, catering to enthusiastic water sports enthusiasts of all levels.</p><p> </p>						</div>

Wir kommen gerne wieder 🙂<!-- R-CONTENT --></div> <span class="ti-read-more" data-container=".ti-review-content" data-collapse-text="Hide" data-open-text="Read more"></span> </div> </div>  <div data-empty="0" class="ti-review-item source-Google" > <div class="ti-inner"> <div class="ti-review-header"> <div class="ti-profile-img"> <img decoding="async" src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLgYqEDOfLo1acQW9GOttAsW7FWjU4-AsvZo7-LTGHE=s120-c-rp-mo-br100" alt="Julie Reisch" /> </div> <div class="ti-profile-details"> <div class="ti-name"> Julie Reisch </div> <div class="ti-date">2023-01-07</div> </div> </div> <span class="ti-stars"><span class="ti-star f"></span><span class="ti-star f"></span><span class="ti-star f"></span><span class="ti-star f"></span><span class="ti-star f"></span></span> <div class="ti-review-text-container ti-review-content"><!-- R-CONTENT -->Ich kann Santa Kite nur empfehlen. Der Besitzer Ricardo ist super freundlich. Er kann viele Sprachen sprechen (u.a. Deutsch, Englisch, Französisch, Spanisch..) und ist dadurch super flexibel. Auch Dani der Mitarbeiter ist total nett. Sie geben nicht nur Kitekurse, sondern man kann auch Equipment ausleihen und sie organisieren Transfer. Surfbretter kann man übrigens auch leihen. Wenn man in Santa Maria auf der Suche nach einer guten Kite-Schule ist, kann ich Santa Kite wirklich nur empfehlen. Ich würde dort immer wieder hingehen.<!-- R-CONTENT --></div> <span class="ti-read-more" data-container=".ti-review-content" data-collapse-text="Hide" data-open-text="Read more"></span> </div> </div>  <div data-empty="0" class="ti-review-item source-Google" > <div class="ti-inner"> <div class="ti-review-header"> <div class="ti-profile-img"> <img decoding="async" src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKbxvWZAnVeivDDjNlfBRQmavUublkwJ--7J4NrkLei=s120-c-rp-mo-br100" alt="S Schmid" /> </div> <div class="ti-profile-details"> <div class="ti-name"> S Schmid </div> <div class="ti-date">2020-02-22</div> </div> </div> <span class="ti-stars"><span class="ti-star f"></span><span class="ti-star f"></span><span class="ti-star f"></span><span class="ti-star f"></span><span class="ti-star f"></span></span> <div class="ti-review-text-container ti-review-content"><!-- R-CONTENT -->Wir haben zwei Wochen bei Santa Kite verbracht. Die Unterkunft direkt über dem Cafe und der Kiteschule war günstig, nahe am Strand, sauber und gemütlich. Die Gastgeber waren super freundlich und das Frühstück lecker. Auch die Kiteschule können wir sehr empfehlen - kompetente, erfahrene und aufgestellte Surflehrer, die uns zu schnellem Lernerfolg verhelfen konnten. Wir würden sofort wieder kommen!<!-- R-CONTENT --></div> <span class="ti-read-more" data-container=".ti-review-content" data-collapse-text="Hide" data-open-text="Read more"></span> </div> </div>  <div data-empty="0" class="ti-review-item source-Google" > <div class="ti-inner"> <div class="ti-review-header"> <div class="ti-profile-img"> <img decoding="async" src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXsFDsSJnNMI8fLrSXQZGpjalMerWI8RNKCddWQkIkiqw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100" alt="Marek L" /> </div> <div class="ti-profile-details"> <div class="ti-name"> Marek L </div> <div class="ti-date">2019-12-08</div> </div> </div> <span class="ti-stars"><span class="ti-star f"></span><span class="ti-star f"></span><span class="ti-star f"></span><span class="ti-star f"></span><span class="ti-star f"></span></span> <div class="ti-review-text-container ti-review-content"><!-- R-CONTENT -->really good school and even better instructors 😁🤘 swim jumping to have fun<!-- R-CONTENT --></div> <span class="ti-read-more" data-container=".ti-review-content" data-collapse-text="Hide" data-open-text="Read more"></span> </div> </div>  </div> <div class="ti-controls-line"> <div class="dot"></div> </div> </div> <div class="ti-footer"> <div class="ti-rating-text"> <span class="nowrap"><strong>Google</strong> rating score: </span><span class="nowrap"><strong>5.0</strong> of 5, </span><span class="nowrap">based on <strong>18 reviews</strong></span> </div> </div>  </div> </div></div>

Enjoy cozy rooms and apartments perfect for groups and families.
